chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:
A man makes what he catches with the Imam the beginning of his salat (prayer). Jaʿfar said: And we do not say as the foolish ones say.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: caught up with or attained in time
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat

ai.seo_question: When joining congregational salat late, does what I catch with the Imam count as the beginning or the end of my prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling for one who joins congregational salat (prayer) after missing part of it: what he catches with the Imam counts as the beginning of his own prayer. It also explicitly rejects a contrary view attributed to the ignorant or foolish.
